texts.preamble: M/S L And A Cafe vs The State Of Telangana on 22 September, 2025 The Honourable Sri Justice N.V.Shravan Kumar Writ Petition Nos.3678 and 24222 of 2025 Common Order:
texts.facts: 2. W.P.No.3678 of 2025 is filed seeking following prayer:- "to issue a proper writ, order or orders particularly one in the nature of Writ of Mandamus declaring the action of the respondents No.1 to 7 in interfering with the petitioners business F3 CAFE situated at H.No.1-62/K/1/44, 4th and 5th Floor, Kavuri Hills, Guttala Begumpet, Jubliee Hills, Hyderabad as illegal, arbitrary highhanded apart from being violative of Articles 14 and 19 1 g of Constitution of India consequently direct the respondents not to interfere with the petitioner business F3 CAFE situated at H.No.1-62/K/1/44, 4th and 5th Floor, Kavuri Hills, Guttala Begumpet, Jubliee Hills, Hyderabad." 3. W.P.No.24222 of 2025 is filed seeking following prayer:- "to issue a writ order or direction more particularly one in the nature of Writ of Mandamus direct the respondents herein to allow the petitioner to earmark his designated smoking area as per the COTPA Act and to allow his clientele to use the same as they please as long as they are following the same COTPA Act, 2003 in the name and style as M/s. L and A Cafe Situated at Door No.2-65/SVA/100, SV Arcade, Sy.No.54/A and 54/E, Khajaguda Main Road, Circle No.20, Serilingampally, Hyderabad, without reference to rule law or regulations as illegal arbitrary unconstitutional and contrary to the provisions of COTP Act and consequently direct the respondents to permit the petitioner to continue his business of serving flavoured Hookahs in his shop in the name and style as M/s. L and A Cafe Situated at Door No.2-65/SVA/100, SV Arcade, Sy.No.54/A and 54/E, Khajaguda Main Road, Circle No.20, Serilingampally, Hyderabad without any hindrance or restrictions." 4. Brief facts stated in these writ petitions are that petitioners are running a caf in the subject premises and are having license to carry out the business of caf/restaurant and as a part of business, petitioners also offers food and beverages, and also intends to offer flavoured hookah services to the customers as per norms and conditions. Petitioners are also having trade licenses from the GHMC and also license from the Government of Telangana Food Safety and Standards M/S L And A Cafe vs The State Of Telangana on 22 September, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/88678180/ 1 Authority of India. It is submitted that respondent authorities had interfered with the business of the petitioners and not allowing to run the business. Questioning the same these writ petitions are filed.
texts.arguments: Learned counsel for the petitioners submits that this Court vide common order dated 15.11.2023 in W.P.No.8223 of 2013 and batch, passed the following order:- "24. v) If there is any violation of the provisions of the COTP Act and the Rules made thereunder, the respondents-police are at liberty to take appropriate action as per the provisions of the COTP Act.
